name: ssff-mcp

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: Lists the environments configured for this server (aliases and auth type only; no URLs or credentials). Takes no arguments.

tools.name: inspect_entity
tools.description: Reads the data model from the cached $metadata; no data request is made. Without entitySet it lists entities as { name, isCustom }; customOnly narrows to Custom MDF objects (adding isEffectiveDated, linkType, targetEntity, matchField, plus employeeLinkedCount), employeeLinkedOnly narrows that list further to the ones tied to a User or EmpEmployment, and query filters names by substring. With entitySet it returns that entity's schema; Custom MDF entities also carry isCustom, isEffectiveDated, employeeLink and query guidance (suggested $filter, $orderby, warnings, and a ready query_entity example). Always query a custom entity as the root with $filter and $top; expanding it from User returns the whole child collection. locale selects the language of the guidance prose (the user's language, e.g. es_ES).

entitySet.description: Entity set to detail (e.g. 'User', 'cust_EmployeeEquipment'). If omitted, lists entities.

customOnly.description: When listing, keep only Custom MDF objects and add their classification fields. Default: false.

employeeLinkedOnly.description: When listing Custom MDF objects, keep only those tied to a User or EmpEmployment. Requires customOnly.

query.description: When listing, keep entities whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

locale.description: Locale for the guidance text, normally the user's own language (e.g. 'es_ES'). It takes precedence over config defaultLocale, SF_DEFAULT_LOCALE and the 'en_US' fallback.

tools.name: query_entity
tools.description: Reads entity data from SAP SuccessFactors OData v2 for the selected environment. entityPath examples: "User", "User('123')", "Foobar(key1='a',key2=1)/navProperty". Options map 1:1 to OData system query options and their values pass through unmodified: filter -> $filter, orderby -> $orderby, select -> $select, expand -> $expand, top -> $top, skip -> $skip, inlinecount -> $inlinecount (allpages only). The configured entityAllowlist/entityDenylist is enforced on the first path segment AND on every navigation destination, including every $expand route: a hop whose target entity set is not permitted fails with ENTITY_NOT_ALLOWED, a hop the metadata does not model fails with NAVIGATION_NOT_ALLOWED, and an $expand the server cannot fully parse (including $filter or $orderby nested inside it) fails with OPTION_INVALID instead of being dispatched unverified. An allowlist entry may also carry fields: the properties that entity exposes (its keys are always readable). References to a property outside that list fail with ENTITY_NOT_ALLOWED, the returned records are redacted to the permitted properties, and when fields apply the xml output is downgraded to JSON with outputDowngraded: true. Effective dating: fromDate, toDate and asOfDate (bare YYYY-MM-DD, NOT $-prefixed; SuccessFactors ignores the $-prefixed forms) select the effective-dated slices; asOfDate is exclusive and cannot be combined with fromDate or toDate. Ceiling: at most 1000 records and exactly one OData page are returned per call; next links are never followed automatically (hasMore indicates a next page exists). Continuation: when hasMore is true the response may carry an opaque cursor; to fetch the exact next page, re-issue the SAME call (same environment, entityPath and options) passing that cursor as the cursor argument. The cursor is a signed envelope tied to this server process: it is rejected (CURSOR_INVALID) when altered, reused with different arguments, or after a server restart; skip cannot be combined with cursor. inlinecount "allpages" returns totalCount when the service provides __count. output selects the representation: "json" (default, unwrapped records) or "xml" (raw service XML body, hasMore/totalCount/cursor reported in structuredContent).

fromDate.description: Effective-dating window start, format YYYY-MM-DD. Sent as the bare fromDate query parameter (not $-prefixed). Cannot be combined with asOfDate.

toDate.description: Effective-dating window end, format YYYY-MM-DD. Sent as the bare toDate query parameter (not $-prefixed). Cannot be combined with asOfDate.

asOfDate.description: Effective-dating point in time, format YYYY-MM-DD. Sent as the bare asOfDate query parameter (not $-prefixed). Cannot be combined with fromDate or toDate.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous response. Repeat the SAME environment, entityPath and options of the call that produced it and pass the cursor to fetch the exact next page. Rejected (CURSOR_INVALID) if altered, reused with different arguments, or after a server restart. Cannot be combined with skip.

inlinecount.description: Adds $inlinecount=allpages; the response includes totalCount when the service provides __count.

output.description: Response representation: "json" (default, unwrapped records) or "xml" (raw service XML body).

tools.name: batch_get
tools.description: Executes multiple read-only OData v2 GETs against the selected environment in ONE $batch POST. Each item uses exactly the query_entity GET grammar (entityPath plus optional filter, orderby, select, expand, fromDate, toDate, asOfDate, top, skip, cursor, inlinecount); there is no field for HTTP method, URL, host, headers, body or changesets, and unknown keys are rejected before dispatch. fromDate, toDate and asOfDate are bare YYYY-MM-DD effective-dating options (NOT $-prefixed); asOfDate is exclusive and cannot be combined with fromDate or toDate. Hard limits: 1 to 180 items per call (SAP $batch limit) and at most 1000 records returned in TOTAL across all items; items are processed in input order and truncated records are flagged (truncatedToCeiling) when the aggregate ceiling is hit. Every item is fully validated BEFORE the batch is dispatched (path grammar, entity allowlist, option bounds, cursor binding, $metadata classification): one invalid item rejects the whole batch with no $batch POST issued (a metadata GET for classification is the only allowed call). The entityAllowlist/entityDenylist is enforced per item on the first path segment AND on every navigation destination, including every $expand route; one denied, unresolvable or unparseable item rejects the whole batch before the POST. Allowlist entries may carry fields (permitted properties, keys always readable): an item referencing a non-permitted property rejects the batch, records are redacted, and when fields apply the xml output is downgraded to JSON with outputDowngraded: true per item. The response contains one entry per item in input order with per-item status: { index, path, success, httpStatus, recordCount, records|body, hasMore, cursor?, totalCount?, truncatedToCeiling? }; per-item failures carry a sanitized error, never the raw service body. output selects the representation for the whole call: "json" (default, unwrapped records) or "xml" (raw Atom item bodies, Accept: application/atom+xml). Continuation cursors work exactly like query_entity cursors and must be replayed with the same environment, entityPath and options.

fromDate.description: Effective-dating window start, format YYYY-MM-DD. Sent as the bare fromDate query parameter (not $-prefixed). Cannot be combined with asOfDate.

toDate.description: Effective-dating window end, format YYYY-MM-DD. Sent as the bare toDate query parameter (not $-prefixed). Cannot be combined with asOfDate.

asOfDate.description: Effective-dating point in time, format YYYY-MM-DD. Sent as the bare asOfDate query parameter (not $-prefixed). Cannot be combined with fromDate or toDate.

output.description: Response representation for the whole call: "json" (default) or "xml" (raw Atom item bodies).

instructions: Read-only MCP server for SAP SuccessFactors OData v2. Name the environment explicitly; in inline mode (a single configured environment) it may be omitted.
